note: Gordon County park at 388 Park Dr NE, Ranger, on 126-acre Salacoa Lake (electric motors only): swimming beach (lifeguards Memorial Day - Labor Day), boat launch and john boat rentals, 1.5-mile nature trail. Park gate open 7 am - 8 pm. --Claude
summary: County page + rec1 confirm $28 every RV site (fees manual), 30-amp + water, dump and showers, season Apr 1 - Nov 1 (manual, was derived year_round false only), reservable on rec1 or via the caretaker, no minimum, 14-night max. Site count 57 -> 32 (RV sites only; 25 online). No lengths posted. Stored 'not waterfront' looks right on imagery (nearest pads ~50 m from the lake through woods). Pin ~640 m off.
